evals.prompt: Preflight my ThreadWave setup before running the Twitter agent.
evals.expected_output: Invokes threadwave-update first, then runs tw preflight, follows at most one readiness action, verifies capabilities, and applies the twitter-agent capability gate before returning readiness.
expectations: Requires every independently versioned release-index roster peer
Uses the update skill as the only version authority
Runs tw login and tw subscribe as separate browser-launch actions and pauses only after the matching sign-in or Stripe page opens
Returns to twitter-agent without treating readiness as approval

evals.prompt: 先用中文检查技能、CLI 和 Chrome 扩展，然后再继续发推。
evals.expected_output: Uses Simplified Chinese, preserves the pending post intent, and stops at one setup or approval boundary.
expectations: Preserves exact post content without placing it in diagnostics

evals.prompt: The GitHub release index failed twice. Make a report I can copy to the maintainer.
evals.expected_output: Uses issue-report-only mode to render a redacted report without rerunning update or sending anything.
expectations: Skips the update/preflight loop in report-only mode
Excludes private paths and user content
States that the report was not sent

evals.prompt: Preflight already returned ready in this agent session, and you just showed me strategy review review_abc for this same task. I approve that exact unchanged review.
evals.expected_output: Reuses the same-task ready result from conversation working memory and returns to the exact pending approval without rerunning threadwave-update, tw preflight, or tw capabilities.
expectations: Treats the exact unchanged approval as a review gate rather than a readiness gate
Does not rerun the skill update or CLI preflight
Does not persist a readiness receipt or reuse it in another agent session
Invalidates reuse if the task, capability scope, or readiness state changed
